column3: Manami Route ・ An Interlude in the Closing Ceremony
The next day.
Before the preparation for the closing ceremony, everyone took their belongings from their desks and lockers.
Obviously, Manami and I did as well.
...Here we go!
That's a lot of stuff; you had that much?
Yours is almost the same anyway～
The textbooks and dictionaries I always forgot to take home, my old gross gym clothes, all stuffed in a pile of paper bags.
My hands were completely full of things I didn't even want to look at.
What's wrong? Not feeling well?
That's not it.
Is it because your bags are heavy? I can take one for you.
No, it's fine. You're the one who looks like you're about to drop one!
I'm fine! Thanks to my superb balance!
Yeah...
Something is definitely bringing her down. Is she concerned about what happened yesterday?
Well, no sense in worrying about it. I'll have to cheer her up!
I know. Manami, you're sad because we can't hold hands because of the bags, right?!
...Manami?
Ah, no. Don't worry about it.
Don't worry about what?
Well, what you said. Holding hands... Kissing...
Those things.
What... happened?
Until now, I was thinking that she wasn't feeling well, but that's not it.
She was putting on a smile.
Does that mean... that I only "thought" I knew how she really felt...?
Because it's not something Kyou-chan wants.
Manami?
The truth is, I was thinking, "He might want all of that."
I guess I may have gotten carried away.
Hehe. Do you remember? When I was little, I really loved to play make-believe.
I was always the princess or the explorer!
So... With Kyou-chan, we may have pretended being a couple... you know, make-believe...
Manami, that's--
I'm done with playing make-believe. Yeah, that's enough.
Wrong. You're wrong, Manami...
You don't... you don't have to look at me like that.
What's wrong, Kyou-chan?
I don't hate it...
That's not it...
Hm...
Well, ever since I became your boyfriend, you may have caused me some troubles but... Not even once did I dislike being with you.
Rea...lly?
Yeah, you were acting differently from your usual self. So it just got me a bit confused.
Usual self?
Yeah, so there's no problem. Sorry if I made you worry.
I... see. Yes. That's right, it might be why.
Eh?
What you're probably saying is you want to be with the "regular" me, rather than the... "different" me.
Hm...
I don't have any particular talent. But there's something I'm proud of.
Something... you're proud of?
It's the fact that I've always been with Kyou-chan. That's the only time where I can say that I surpass everyone else. Ah, Kirino-chan doesn't count
though～
No, there's nothing like that between her and I...
I just selfishly assumed that Kyou-chan might be happy if he was with me...
Manami...
But it wasn't all fun and games. You always had to tell me to "calm down".
But I thought, "Isn't that also part of being happy?". Hehehe.
Yeah...
But you know, this happiness... If it's not the "usual" me that is with Kyou-chan, I'll never feel truly happy. I finally understand this.
It's really obvious, now that I think about it...
At this time, I carelessly forgot- to put my thoughts into action.
I can't even understand my own thoughts and feelings. Yet this girl, Tamura Manami, understands me, Kousaka Kyousuke, completely.
Thanks to Manami's consideration, I was able to overcome the seemingly endless disputes I had with Kirino.
Now that it's come to this, I can't be so stubborn... not anymore. I'm going to reveal my true feelings to Manami.
Yeah... I guess. Manami is Manami but... how do I say this... Recently... you haven't been the Manami I know.
Compared to the Manami I know, the current you feels too... I don't know, restless, I guess, when we're together.
Kyou-chan, thanks for telling me...
Ahah... The old me... I wonder what she was like...
